cohort: 120 females with a singleton pregnancy of 36-40 weeks, requiring a non-emergency elective cesarean section.
finding: Women receiving general anesthesia reported higher satisfaction compared to those receiving spinal anesthesia, but no significant difference was observed in neonatal APGAR scores between the two anesthesia types.
cross-section timing: APGAR score assessed at 5 minutes after delivery; patient satisfaction recorded post-operatively.
